title: skills: list the form thank-you translation keys in the objectstack-i18n _views row
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibx5r5nhDMwpRs4SL6D

Filing gate: ③ the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of PR #28195 (#28004), filed by the seat before ACCEPT as the claim template requires. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane and grade.
Reach: an AI author translating a public form from the `objectstack-i18n` skill does not learn the thank-you keys, so the panel after submit stays untranslated.

## Wanted

- `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` L163, the `_views.{view_name}` row, lists `submitBehavior.title` / `submitBehavior.message` beside the form `title` (a form whose `submitBehavior` is `thank-you`; only authored copy is translated).
- Contract review 6528389425 S2: land it with, not after, the next edit to the i18n skill. Nothing else waits on it (the key is live in PR #28195; the console draws the served panel). Governed path (`skills/**`): Tier H.

Links back: #28004, PR #28195.

Blocked-by: #28195
